t: Forge Steel 20" (500mm) universal panel saw is an essential wood cutting tool for carpenters, joiners, and DIY enthusiasts undertaking tasks such as cutting timber for framing or trimming sheet materials. The 0.9mm thick, heat-treated carbon steel blade features an anti-rust oil coating, ensuring exceptional durability and resistance to corrosion, and extending the tool's lifespan in demanding workshop conditions. Equipped with 7tpi double-ground teeth to provide effortless, clean cuts through various wood types. The comfortable ergonomic plastic handle with soft-grip design offers enhanced control and precision, reducing user fatigue during prolonged use.
